headlines.title: What Is Honeywell (HON) Trying To Achieve With Its New EBI One Platform?
headlines.summary: Honeywell International (NasdaqGS: HON) introduced its AI-powered building automation platform, EBI One, at its Accelerate 2026 event. The company also presented advanced safety and security technologies aimed at more autonomous building operations. Management positioned EBI One as a central hub for managing building systems using artificial intelligence for more coordinated control.

headlines.title: Introducing the New Honeywell HEPA 3-in-1 Air Comfort System with Turbo360™, Combining Air Purification, Fan and Air Circulation in One
headlines.summary: Helen of Troy Limited today announced the Canadian launch of the new Honeywell HEPA 3-in-1 Air Comfort System with Turbo360™. Combining an air purifier, fan and air circulator in one convenient unit, the new 3-in-1 system is designed to help Canadians enjoy cleaner air and greater comfort at home throughout the year. Honeywell HEPA air purifiers are the #1 brand most trusted by doctors in Canada, according to a 2026 BrandSpark® survey of physicians practicing in Canada.

headlines.title: Honeywell Technologies Unveils New EBI, Fire and Life Safety and Security Innovations That Bring More Intelligent, Autonomous Operations to Buildings
headlines.summary: ORLANDO, Fla., November 10, 2026--Honeywell Technologies (NASDAQ: HON) today introduced a set of new AI-powered building automation offerings, including EBI One, fire and life safety, and security innovations at Accelerate 2026, its largest-ever industry event with more than 2,000 customers and partners.

description: Honeywell International Inc. engages in the industrial automation, building automation, and energy and sustainability solutions businesses in the United States, Europe, and internationally. The Industrial Automation segment provides automation control and instrumentation products and services; smart energy products; sensing technologies, including custom-engineered sensors and related services; gas detection technologies and personal protective equipment; and system design automation equipment, as well as software and analytics for manufacturing, distribution, and fulfillment operations. The Building Automation segment provides software applications for building control and optimization; sensors, switches, control systems, and instruments for energy management; access control; video surveillance; fire products; and installation, maintenance, and system upgrade services. The Energy and Sustainability Solutions segment, through its UOP business, delivers licensed process technology, equipment, engineering, catalysts, adsorbents, and services for refining, petrochemicals, low-carbon energy, gas and LNG, and industrial solutions, as well as connectivity, data integration, and software solutions. The company also offers Forge Cognition, a self-contained agentic AI and simulation platform for facility operations. The company was formerly known as AlliedSignal, Inc. Honeywell International Inc. was founded in 1885 and is headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina.
